title: Chiseled Bookshelf Viewer
description: Annoyed that you can't view the books in a Chiseled Bookshelf without taking them out? Now you can by Sneaking + Right Click on a Chiseled Bookshelf.
body:
This Spigot Plugin has one simple feature: And that feature is, to "look inside" a Chiseled Bookshelf. By Sneaking + Right clicking on a Chiseled Bookshelf, a small UI will show and you can look at what books there are.

![Inside a Chiseled Bookshelf](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b80343d07650d2a8dea0f8c3438fad91d56a4855_0.webp)
